command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 -J root@100.71.48.1 root@72.61.19.188 'set -euo pipefail; for p in /etc/entityos/tresor /etc/clayverse/freie-zugaenge.env /etc/clayverse/keys.env /etc/clayverse/github-token.env; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then if [ -r "$p" ]; then r=yes; else r=no; fi; if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo "$p exists=yes readable=$r type=dir"; find "$p" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf "  %f size=%s mode=%m\n" | sort; else echo "$p exists=yes readable=$r type=file size=$(stat -c %s "$p") mode=$(stat -c %a "$p")"; fi; else echo "$p exists=no"; fi; done'
